root_cause.text: In btrfs's tree-log code, when `log_conflicting_inodes` logs the parent directory of a conflicting inode (as a side effect of logging the conflicting inode), it fails to subsequently call `log_new_dir_dentries` to persist the new dentries of that parent directory, causing them to be missing after a power failure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a call to `log_new_dir_dentries(trans, inode, ctx)` after `btrfs_log_inode` in the loop of `log_conflicting_inodes`, conditional on `ctx->log_new_dentries` being set. The commit message explicitly states: "If we log the parent directory of a conflicting inode, we are not logging the new dentries of the directory ... Fix this by ensuring we log new dir dentries whenever we log the parent directory of a no longer existing conflicting inode." The diff shows the insertion of this logic (saving `orig_log_new_dentries`, setting it to false before logging, then after logging checking and calling `log_new_dir_dentries` if needed).
